20vc._readme: Durable identity corrections consumed by build-company-base.py on every rebuild (COLLECTION.md s8): one company rendered under different names across 20VC's surfaces (the live 20vc.fund list of 2026, the podcast site's portfolio pages 2022-2024, the press and Form D issuer names) and its renames. Canonical = the firm's current rendering where the company is still listed. Written at kickoff (PRO-76, 2026-09-28).

merges.name: Junction
merges.reason: one company: Vital (tryvital.io, health-data API) renamed itself Junction in 2024; the podcast site's page (slug vital, 2022-2024) carries the old name, the live card the new one ('One API for all health data', junction.com)

merges.name: Noh Payments
merges.reason: one company: the podcast site's page slug is divy and its title Noh (the Brazilian joint-account app renamed from Divy); the live card calls it Noh Payments (noh.com.br)
